fixtures.notes: Two Calves opened by two Agent tool_use blocks of ONE assistant message (message.id msg_011CeBHoaANeHxzXxS7ibjFc, lines 3 and 6). Their messages interleave — 7 lane switches. The dispatch tool is named 'Agent' in CLI 2.1.235, not 'Task'; match on both.

Depth 2. Depth is recovered by chaining parent_tool_use_id: the Agent tool_use toolu_015KWKbkSggrkWHhrmaMsubr on line 8 sits in a message whose own parent_tool_use_id is non-null. ORDERING HAZARD: system/task_started for the depth-2 lane is emitted on line 7, BEFORE the assistant tool_use that opens it on line 8. The router must tolerate task_started preceding its dispatch block — it cannot assume the tool_use has already been seen when the lane-open arrives.
One foreground Calf opening and closing normally. The baseline; 05-malformed is derived from this file.

SUBSTITUTION — read before writing this fixture's test. fixture-corpus.md §1 asks for "a Calf with no tool_result at turn end". CLI 2.1.235 CANNOT emit that: every tool_use is answered before the turn's result message. Two paths were tried and both produced a tool_result. (a) Interrupting mid-Calf via Query.interrupt() yields a synthetic is_error tool_result reading "The user doesn't want to proceed with this tool use. The tool use was rejected...". (b) maxTurns: 1 lets the Calf run to completion and still closes it. What this fixture captures instead is a BACKGROUND dispatch (run_in_background: true), the real orphan the router must survive: the lane opens at system/task_started (task_id a5ae6133e7fdf87aa, line 5) and the turn's result arrives on line 8 with no terminal system/task_updated and no system/task_notification. The dispatching Agent tool_use on line 3 IS answered, on line 6, but only by the launch acknowledgement ("Async agent launched successfully"), not by the Calf's work. A router that closes a Calf on the dispatching tool_use's tool_result therefore closes this lane at line 6 and an Orphaned test asserting "tool_use with no tool_result" passes vacuously while proving nothing. ASSERT INSTEAD: a lane opened by system/task_started with no terminal system/task_updated when the result message arrives. Also note this capture contains 0 subagent-originated messages — a background Calf forwards none — so it exercises lane LIFECYCLE only and never lane CONTENT. Use 01/02/03 for content.

canUseTool fired once, for the Write call toolu_01MkAUwWyPMPhRgT4P67ZL95 made inside the Calf, carrying options.agentID a3d3c9443c6195211. Read-only Bash is auto-approved even under permissionMode 'default' and never reaches canUseTool, which is why this Calf writes a file. The callback is (toolName, input, options) — three positional arguments — and options carried agentID, blockedPath, decisionReason, description, displayName, requestId, signal, suggestions, title, toolUseID.
